pages.text: Body Transformation aspects boost the amount of stats body cultivation gives to the cultivator. $(br2)At the bottom left of the Body Refinement Screen you can select the Transformations Group.

$(br2)When the Transformations filter is selected any transformation aspects which meet the required proficiency will apear and you may select one in order to display it on your character. $(br2)If a transformation is selected you may deselect it by double clicking it.
